prompt:
Create THIS specific legendary playable GOD — not a human, not a human in costume, not a powerful human. This is an EXTRADIMENSIONAL DIVINE BEING whose body IS the manifestation of ancient asgardian law. Ancient humans saw Skeld dimly and tried to copy what they saw as myth — Skeld is the SOURCE, not the copy.

GOD: Skeld. Male. Faction: Asgardian. Realm: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Role: Controller.

MYTHOLOGICAL SOURCES — deeply integrated into anatomy, not worn as accessories:

1. YGGDRASIL — The World Tree, Root Architecture of the Nine Worlds
   - Ancient humans saw the root-structure growing through his body and copied it as a world tree. His body IS the root system — WORLD-ROOT VEINS run through his skin, visible as glowing green-gold channels that connect to the terrain itself. His skin is BARK-IRON — dark, textured like living ash-wood fused with storm-steel, clearly not human.
2. NINE-WORLD CROSSINGS — Root-Engineered Gateways
   - His shoulders carry ROOT-NODE PAULDRONS — growths of living ash-wood and iron that pulse with the energy of the Nine Worlds. His core is a ROOT-HEART — a visible nexus of root-energy that connects him to the battlefield terrain. His eyes are ROOT-SIGHT EYES — deep green-gold that sees the root-structure beneath any surface.
3. TERRAIN CONTROL — The Power to Bend the Battlefield
   - His arms are ROOT-EXTENSIONS — limbs that end in root-iron claws, capable of extending into the ground. His legs are TRUNK-LEGS — massive, bark-covered, planted like tree-roots. The ground around him responds — roots grow, walls rise, terrain bends to his will.

NON-HUMAN ANATOMY — This being is unmistakably NOT human:
- Proportions are WRONG for a human: too tall, too precise, built at COLOSSAL scale. The camera looks UP at him/her. This is a DIVINE BEING that ancient humans tried to remember as a person.
- Skin is clearly not human: storm-root anatomy with rune scars cut like old wounds, iron-and-ash skin grain, frost-light joints, oath-ring growths, raven-shadow eyes, thunder moving in veins. It has a mineral, divine quality — energy patterns show THROUGH the skin as glowing channels, not painted on the surface.
- Face: square wolf-jaw face with flattened warrior nose, close-set amber eyes, cropped battle braids, and frost-bitten cheekbones; unique to Skeld through the three-bead brow line facial/cranial rhythm A human could never wear this face — it is too clean, too precise, too symmetrical, as if carved from divine law.
- Body: tall angular strategist body, long hands, narrow waist, commanding cloak/halo span, measured predatory stillness; height/proportion offset 12: wolf-jaw pauldron changes the black-shape read The proportions read as DIVINE, not mortal.
- Bare head — NO halo rings, NO discs, NO circles behind or around the head. The head is completely bare.
- Every element of the body must feel like it GREW from divine anatomy, not like it was PUT ON as costume.

WEAPON: Skeld Compass Rune-Iron Oath Axe
The weapon is made of the same divine material as the body — it looks like an EXTENSION of the deity, not a separate object. It is held with deliberate purpose, not generic combat posing. The weapon's silhouette must be unique to this deity and not shared by any other.

ARMOR (grown from divine body, not worn): Armor must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.; construction proves source culture humans later copied as Norse myth; no cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor.
Full-body living myth-source Deity, not a costume: Skeld shows storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow..
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Every plate, inlay, and marking must have a mythological reason for existing. No generic plate armor, no interchangeable faction gear.

MATERIALS (grown from divine body, not worn): primary: dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur; secondary: raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white, blackwinter frost; accent: funeral ember, world-root bark
COLOR PALETTE: dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur, raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white, blackwinter frost, funeral ember, world-root bark
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Materials pulse with living energy — this is divine anatomy, not metalworked armor.

POSE: Three-quarter hero stance, face clearly visible, weapon clearly visible. Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm. shown through expression and gesture. Premium playable character presentation saying "this is a GOD you can unlock and command." The pose expresses the Controller role through readable tactical intent, not generic action posing.

SILHOUETTE: vertical command silhouette with crown/halo/mantle spread, long gesture hand, and battlefield-rule presence plus spiral hip-chain so the character reads alone in silhouette The silhouette reads as a COLOSSAL DIVINE BEING, not a human warrior. Even in pure black silhouette, no one would mistake this for a human. Key silhouette markers: terrain law, threshold command, battlefield geometry, source culture humans later copied as Norse myth, storm steel.

ENVIRONMENT: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds — extradimensional divine realm. Environments must show The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds as the source behind human mythic spaces, not a themed set.; Landmarks, weather, hazards, and sacred architecture physically shape movement. Cinematic lighting. Readable full-body focus. No clutter.

ART STYLE: Premium stylized-realistic 3D mythological fantasy character. NOT anime, NOT manga, NOT chibi, NOT photoreal, NOT generic AI fantasy, NOT sci-fi. This is a GOD — the first thing the viewer sees must be "that is NOT a human, that is a divine being." Living divine anatomy, not robotic, not blocky architecture. The non-human nature is the PRIMARY design directive, not an afterthought. AAA-quality game character concept for a premium mobile tactical RPG.

AVOID: cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor, glowing UI runes, blocky hammer mech, modern biker leather, random Celtic knotwork.
